{{Quote|Grievous is out there, sitting on his clanky butt thinking he's got us whipped before we fire a single shot. I'm in the mood to contradict him, boys. How about you?|Captain Fireball to the members of Gold Squadron|<ref name="Stealth" />}}
"'''Gold Four'''" was a [[clone trooper pilot]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Gold Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] under the command of [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Fireball (clone pilot)|Fireball]]. Gold Four [[Death/Legends|died]] during the [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|Battle of Kothlis]],<ref name="Stealth" /> in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="TERC" />
